content: There exist many sentences that contain neither manual nor predicted annotations. We treat these as maximally easy sentences (with difficulty scores of 0). Such sentences comprise 51%, 42% and 36% for Population, Interventions and Outcomes data respectively, indicating that it is easier to identify sentences that have no Population spans, but harder to identify sentences that have no Interventions or Outcomes spans. This is intuitive as descriptions of the latter two tend to be more technical and dense with medical jargon.
